name: D · 잉크 민트
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a production-quality game UI design proposal, a large landscape 3:2 board (1536x1024 or higher) with EXACTLY THREE complete equal-size 9:16 portrait screens side by side: "01 로비", "02 전투", "03 장비". No device frames. Korean mobile game TRIO CHESS. This is a new DARK UI VARIATION, not a different game. The central battle HUD MUST preserve the original game's compact layout. THE HIGHEST PRIORITY IS ORIGINAL BATTLE LAYOUT AND VERY THIN HERO STRIP.
REFERENCE ROLES IN ORDER:
Image 1: ORIGINAL BATTLE SCREEN, authoritative for all central panel geometry, icon sizes, original 3D camera, bright lime-green world and tan road. This is the most important reference.
Image 2: ORIGINAL LOBBY, authoritative for content and the 3 toy heroes and campfire island.
Image 3: ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT, authoritative for equipment functions, colorful item icon identity and data hierarchy.
Image 4: PREVIOUS NIGHT ARCADE design, approved ONLY for dark indigo/mint visual mood. Its tall hero cards and giant skill buttons were REJECTED BY USER. Do not copy its battle layout or its large illustrated skill discs.
CENTRAL BATTLE GEOMETRY LOCK: Coordinates below are relative to a 720x1280 screen and should scale uniformly to your middle portrait panel. Do not print rulers or coordinate labels in the image. Keep original full 3D scene visible until y=806 (63% of screen). Top currencies and route are thin and match Image 1. 
- Six original small skill indicators ONLY: one row anchored at y=806, row height64. Each circle diameter58 (8% of screen width), three groups of two. Preserve compact short Korean labels "강습 충격 / 사격 포화 / 영도 번개", small cooldown numerals and thin readiness rim. They float directly over the game world with transparent space behind, NO full-width backplate. Do NOT use large beautiful action icons or thick illustrated buttons.
- Three original hero status capsules ONLY: one single row y=876..922, TOTAL HEIGHT46 (3.6% of screen height), width214 each, gaps9. A small round hero face at left, two tiny horizontal lines (green HP / blue mana) beside face, tiny level at right. These are thin horizontal PILLS exactly as Image 1, NOT rectangles with a header and rows of statistics. No hero names, no "Lv.4" headings, no numerical health values, no separate title rows. Never stack a portrait above bars. The full compact skill+status region is just116px high or9.1% of1280. Everything above y806 remains battle scenery.
- Inventory stays at ORIGINAL y=938..1162 (73.3%..90.8%), seven columns x two rows, exactly14 slots, header "가방 3/14" and small "판매". First THREE slots filled, others empty. Use dark understated translucent inventory surface, world still faintly visible through it.
- Bottom five-item nav starts y1162 and ends1280, height118 (9.2%), labels "상점 영웅 전투 특성 도감", small active 전투. Same original footprint.
- Enemies remain in the upper field, the 3 heroes remain just above the original tiny skill circles, same perspective as Image1. Do not zoom or move camera. Bright green world is NOT night, only UI surfaces are dark.
LOBBY: logo "TRIO CHESS", three toy heroes orange-bearded horned warrior / pink-haired green ranger / purple-hatted blue mage and campfire; currencies gold12,480, blue stone86, purple crystal240; side utilities 모닥불/탤런트/출석/토벌/미션. 장비 and 유물 entries. Dark primary expedition panel "원정", chapter "1. 햇살 왕국", biggest CTA "출발". Secondary "끝없는 행군". Only 출석 and 미션 may show tiny notification dots. No debug/UI preset toggle or desktop shortcuts.
EQUIPMENT: dark screen header "장비", three class tabs "워리어 레인저 메이지", three equipped cards "무기 방어구 장신구" with sword/helmet/ring, neat compact level+bonus and gold+blue stone upgrade cost. Lower inventory header "보관함 18" and "모두 합성", dense colorful rarity-coded item grid, selected sword detail area "일식검", gold rarity chip "전설", "공격력 +90", one short effect line, primary "장착", secondary "판매". Keep selected item detail from overlapping grid. Reserve rarity blue/purple/gold for item grade. Consistent clean Korean type, readable large action labels, no hallucinated long numbers, no extra features/currencies/offers.
RESEARCH-INFORMED DESIGN PRINCIPLES: dark menus may carry visual character, combat chrome stays restrained; same semantic icon system, shallow surfaces, contrast at text rather than decorative bright frame everywhere; selective highlights only for main action and skill-ready state. Dark does not mean cyberpunk. Keep existing low-poly toy world.

DIRECTION D / INK MINT. A quiet refined evolution of Night Arcade: matte ink navy #1B2237 and slightly lighter #28334A, off-white #F0F3F8, cool mint #79DFC4 as the only dominant action color, soft slate #9AA9BC. Nearly flat 2D surfaces, fine1px keylines, gently rounded12px corners, restrained rounded Korean typography, no thick glowing rims. No gradients on every button; one shallow highlight only on primary CTA. Compact tonal tabs and segmented panels. Main action mint, secondary buttons dark tonal, notification coral dots. Equipment grid is tidy with small grade markers rather than candy-colored full panel backgrounds. Lobby diorama is unchanged colorful and airy; mature clean graphic UI contrasts with cute characters. Skill circles remain dark and tiny with original text abbreviations, HP capsules a single thin horizontal strip. Do not copy the oversized skill art or tall hero cards from Image4.
Board charcoal background, restrained top heading "D / INK MINT" and a few tiny palette swatches. Composition should feel calm, contemporary and shippable rather than neon fantasy concept art. FINAL CHECK: middle screen skill circles begin63% down; hero capsule row3.6% tall; no large hero cards.
